## My Visualization

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

storms |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(aes(x = category))

```



## Big Question

Count the number of observation for hurricanes with windspeeds above the 75th percentile for observations/hurricanes in that year

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

glimpse(storms)

storms |>
  filter(status == "hurricane") |>
  group_by(year) |>
  mutate(threshold = quantile(wind, prob = 0.75)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(wind > threshold) |>
  count(year) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```
